subject: Recap: pricing targets, model mix, and route onboarding timeline
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sara Kim <sara.kim@ozonelabs.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Jul 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: pricing targets, model mix, and route onboarding timeline

Hi Sara — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and the asks we agreed on so we can align internally and with procurement. Please confirm any numbers that need adjusting.

Summary from our discovery
- Current monthly average usage: ~2.1M tokens (inference + embeddings).
- Target growth over next 6 months: steady ramp to ~7–9M tokens/month (marketing + product features launching).
- Preferred model mix: 70% standard chat / 30% long-context generation and embeddings.
- Key requirement: per-request latency SLOs for chat; embeddings acceptable to be batched.

Budget and pricing signals from your side
- Budget band indicated on call: $8k–$12k / month initial (headline) with willingness to commit if unit economics align.
- Procurement: standard PO + SOW; expect 3–4 week procurement timeline once internal approvals are in place.

Our initial unit-econ framing (for discussion)
- Baseline hosted rate: $1,250 per 1M tokens for chat-gen (current public list for comparable models).
- Proposed blended starting offer for renewal/expansion: tiered blend targeting ~$1,000–$1,100 per 1M across expected mix with step-ups at volume bands.
  - Example: 0–3M @ $1,250/1M; 3–6M @ $1,050/1M; 6M+ @ $900/1M (final blended depends on model routing and commit).

Route onboarding
- Recommendation: add a dedicated "embedding-route-v2" for your analytics pipelines and route chat to "latency-optimized-1". This allows us to present a blended price that reflects different execution costs.

Next steps we agreed
1) Sara to confirm target commit window and procurement POC (procurement@ozonelabs.ai) — by EOD Wed 7/7.
2) Redwood to send a worked pricing workbook showing blended scenarios and a 12-month forecast for 3 commit tiers (3M, 6M, 9M/mo).
3) Tentative technical onboarding window: 2–3 weeks after contract signature to enable route-add and canary.

I've attached a starter pricing workbook (ozone_pricing_workbook.xlsx) with editable volume bands — Ben will follow with a formal proposal.

Appreciate any clarifications; happy to jump on a 20-min sync if helpful.

— Jordan
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Sara Kim <sara.kim@ozonelabs.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: procurement@ozonelabs.ai
Date: Wed, 7 Jul 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: pricing targets, model mix, and route onboarding timeline

Jordan — thanks for the summary and workbook. Quick clarifications from our side: 

- The 7–9M/month number is our stretch target assuming the new recommendation engine ships in Q4. For contracting we can plan on committing to a 6M/month baseline with an option to step up after three months if usage ramps as expected.
- Budget: the $8k–$12k was high-level. Primary procurement ask is to see a committed rate where our forecast spends ~ $7k/month at 6M (we realize that requires a fairly aggressive blended cap). Is there flexibility to show an example where target blended cost = $1,150 / 1M (which nets us ~ $6.9k at 6M)?
- Procurement POC: procurement@ozonelabs.ai (Angela Park). She will own PO terms and needs an initial SOW draft.

Timing: procurement window aligns with your 3–4 week estimate; we can fast-track if legal can sign off on standard MSA + Redwood's SLAs.

Happy to have Angela join a numbers walkthrough tomorrow afternoon if you and Ben are available.

— Sara
Head of Product, Ozone Labs

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sara Kim <sara.kim@ozonelabs.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Jul 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: pricing targets, model mix, and route onboarding timeline — proposed scenarios

Sara / team — appreciate the quick reply and the procurement contact. Attached is a concise pricing workbook (proposed-pricing.xlsx) and three scenarios (Conservative / Commit-6M / Aggressive-StepUp) — summary below.

Key assumptions across all scenarios:
- Model mix: 70% chat (latency-optimized), 30% long-context/embeddings (batch-friendly).
- We assume a modest 15% discount benefit from batching/kv cache on the embedding-heavy portion.
- Commitment term: 12 months for Commit-6M scenario; month-to-month for Conservative.

Scenario highlights (blended $/1M tokens)
- Conservative: no commit, standard hosted pricing; blended ~$1,225/1M.
- Commit-6M (recommended shelf): 6M/mo committed, 12-month term, blended = $1,150/1M (this is exactly your target). Upfront monthly equivalent spend: ~$6,900.
- Aggressive-StepUp: 3M guaranteed + step-up ramp to 9M by month 4, tiered effective blended = $995/1M if step-up achieved; this requires signing a step-up addendum and a short-term 20% additional commit escrow.

Example price bands we can publish in SOW (adjustable):
- 0–3M: $1,250/1M
- 3–6M: $1,050/1M
- 6–12M: $900/1M

Notes on route/add costs
- Adding a dedicated embedding-route-v2 has a one-time onboarding fee (operational) of $2,500 and a 2-week canary window.
- If you require dedicated reserved capacity (low-latency SLOs at peak), that pushes us to a Dedicated offering with an uplift; we can model that in the workbook if needed.

Action items I propose
1) Jordan — confirm which scenario Ozone prefers (Conservative / Commit-6M / Aggressive-StepUp).
2) Sara / Angela — if Commit-6M is acceptable, procurement to share preferred contract template so legal can pre-clear.
3) Ben & Priyom — we’ll prepare a one-page SOW + price table and a short addendum for the step-up mechanics.

Attaching proposed-pricing.xlsx with the calculations. Happy to run the numbers live with Angela tomorrow afternoon — I have 2–3pm PT open.

— Ben
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Attachments: proposed-pricing.xlsx

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sara Kim <sara.kim@ozonelabs.ai>, Angela Park <procurement@ozonelabs.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Jul 2027 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: pricing targets, model mix, and route onboarding timeline — next steps

Thanks everyone — quick confirmation of next steps and timing: 

1) Ozone to confirm scenario: Sara / Angela to confirm Commit-6M or Aggressive-StepUp by EOD Fri 7/9.
2) Ben / Priyom to publish one-page SOW + price table and the step-up addendum draft by Mon 7/12. Link to initial draft in HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DEAL-2027-0457
3) If Commit-6M is chosen, procurement to share contract template; Redwood to return an MSA + SOW in 2 business days for internal legal review.
4) Technical/onboarding planning: tentative 2-week window post-signature — Lauren will coordinate the canary and route-add schedule.

I'll block 30 min for a numbers walkthrough with Angela + Sara for Fri 7/9 at 2pm PT (tentative) — please accept or propose an alternate.

Appreciate the momentum — Ben will drive the pricing doc and Lauren will own the onboarding timeline.

— Jordan
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
